summary: Marker entity created by the server when a savegame is loaded (esv::SessionLoadSystem::Update creates a new entity and adds this component); about 25 server systems (Chasm, Icon, camp chest, crowds, item use, jump ...) read it to skip one-time logic after a load. Born live in situation level-change. Holds an optional copy of the savegame's module (mod) list: ls::Optional<LEGACY_Set<ls::ModuleShortDesc>>.

fields.name: VMT
fields.evidence: macOS esv::SessionLoadSystem::Update stores &PTR_Visit_1094cbd50 (vtable of ls::LEGACY_Set<ls::ModuleShortDesc>) at +0 before cloning the set. Windows: the session-load code bg3.exe+0x2B1D4B0 stores the vtable bg3.exe+0x54C2BB0 at +0 when it fills the optional (and the clone bg3.exe+0x3BC5DD0 does the same).

fields.name: Modules
fields.evidence: new[]-allocated array of ls::ModuleShortDesc (count stored at ptr-8): Windows destructor bg3.exe+0xDBD970 runs _eh_vector_destructor_iterator_ with element size 0x78 over it (macOS 0x60) and frees ptr-8. Not an Array<> (no capacity/size pair before it). Windows: bg3.exe+0x2B1D4B0 moves the clone's buffer pointer into +8.

fields.name: Capacity
fields.evidence: Windows: the copy bg3.exe+0x2FA2CF0 (called by the clone bg3.exe+0x3BC5DD0 on the set +8) treats set+0x10 as the capacity (grows when size == capacity, doubling) and bg3.exe+0x2B1D4B0 copies it to +0x10.

fields.name: Size
fields.evidence: Windows: bg3.exe+0x2FA2CF0 zeroes set+0x14, loops the source's +0x14 times appending 0x78-byte ModuleShortDesc elements and increments +0x14 - the element count; bg3.exe+0x2B1D4B0 copies it to +0x14.

fields.name: Modules
fields.evidence: Value part of an ls::Optional: creator bg3.exe+0x2B20670 (size 0x20) zeroes +0..+0x18; destructor bg3.exe+0xD7A800 destroys it only when the byte at +0x18 is set. macOS SessionLoadSystem::Update fills it from LEGACY_Set<ls::ModuleShortDesc>::Clone of the save's module list.

fields.name: HasModules
fields.evidence: Optional's engaged flag: destructor bg3.exe+0xD7A800 tests +0x18 and clears it; macOS writer sets it to 1 after filling. Live 0 (empty optional).

open_questions: The module elements (ls::ModuleShortDesc, 0x78 bytes) are behind a raw void* (new[] buffer with the count at ptr-8), not an Array<>; Lua sees only Capacity and Size.
second_pass: Confirmed on Windows in the session-load code bg3.exe+0x2B1D4B0 (creates the component with bg3.exe+0x2B20670, fills vtable +0, buffer +8, two uint32 +0x10/+0x14, flag +0x18) and the set copy bg3.exe+0x2FA2CF0, which settles +0x10 = capacity and +0x14 = size.
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
